verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs state that new deployments can be rolled out in increments by sending them to a percentage of traffic first, then promoting or rolling back. Instant rollback to a previous deployment without a rebuild, plus deployment promoted/rollback webhook events, round out blast-radius control. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of rollout configuration (step sizes, automation, health-based gating), independent or hands-on corroboration.
